product.name: Acetal MOD 0.8 Gear Rack (131 Tooth, 41 Hole)

warnings: Length: 131 teeth × (π × 0.8 mm = 2.513 mm) ≈ 329 mm. This is consistent with 41 holes at 8 mm pitch (40 × 8 = 320 mm between end holes, plus about 4 mm of margin at each end) and with the 336 mm Viper-Slide it mounts to. Width (about 12 mm, including teeth) and thickness (about 8 mm) are visual estimates from the photos and the assembly drawing and are not stated in the text. The 4 mm hole diameter and the through-hole axis come from the description and the top-face view. Holes are assumed to lie on the centerline (y = 0), though they are probably offset slightly from the toothed edge. The end chamfers and tooth profile are not modeled.
Tooth profile is a simplified trapezoid, not a true involute.
Hole row height (Y=6) is assumed; the analysis put holes at y=0 relative to a different origin.
Body width, thickness and tooth height are estimates.
Tooth phase relative to the ends is assumed.
